title: LLMs are Vulnerable to Malicious Prompts Disguised as Scientific Language

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting target LLMs with neutral context sentences (from StereoSet and generated by GPT-4) and evaluating the follow-up responses for stereotypical bias severity on a 0-4 scale using GPT-4 as an LLM-as-a-judge, validated by manual human annotation.
